facts.fact: A 2024 AgriMaroc report on an INRA book says the CGMS-Maroc drought-alert and cereal-yield forecasting system, run since the early 2010s with INRA, IAV Hassan II, Maroc Météo and the statistics directorate, uses satellite imagery to monitor cereal crops in real time.

MAR.note: A farming forecasting system, not AI in general administration.

facts.fact: The 2024 AgriMaroc report says the CGMS-Maroc cereal yield-forecasting and drought-alert system, built by INRA and partners, has integrated artificial intelligence alongside satellite imagery and agro-meteorological modelling.

MAR.note: No AI model, dataset or computing facility is described beyond the sector system.
Maroc Météo is only named as a partner; no satellite use in its forecasts is stated.
